text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen was enveloped in bizarre, 
feverish excitement. The reason, besides 
the entries of Zenno Rob Roy and Special 
Week, was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove and Fuji Kiseki also entered 
the race. Both are Umamusume who have 
proven results in GⅠ races. They are 
brimming with spirit ahead of the contest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In contrast to those who drew the crowd's 
attention, Eishin Flash burned with a 
quiet flame, believing the difficult path 
was the one most worth taking—
